info.description: Rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads like a person wrote it. Meaning, facts, names, numbers, and quotes are preserved and verified in the output; AI stock phrases are stripped and natural sentence rhythm is restored. POST /score returns a heuristic analysis of AI-like surface patterns (never a detector verdict). Honest scope: improves naturalness and removes common AI tells; does not guarantee passing any AI detector.
